content: Master Agent Dispatch runs seven QA rounds: doc-qa, defect-hunt, coverage-qa, consolidation-qa, performance-qa, pdsl-qa and qa-retrospective. Each opens a branch with a BRANCH_PREFIX of qa/docs-, qa/defect-, qa/coverage-, qa/consolidate-, qa/performance-, qa/pdsl- and qa/retro- respectively.
The dispatch workflow caps concurrent work at MAX_OPEN_PRS = 7 open pull requests; a planning round does not start while more than that many are already open.
QA retrospective round consumes the exit-interview feedback from the other rounds.
